questions.question:
Statements:
I. Heavy rain lashed the city for three days.
II. Many low-lying areas of the city were waterlogged.

Which of the following is correct?
options: II is the cause and I is its effect
I is the cause and II is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
The two statements are independent of each other
questions.explanation: Waterlogging is the result of the rain, and the rain came first. Answer: I is the cause and II is its effect.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. The school declared a holiday for Monday.
II. A cyclone warning was issued for the district.

Which of the following is correct?
options: II is the cause and I is its effect
I is the cause and II is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
The two statements are independent of each other
questions.explanation: The holiday was declared because of the cyclone warning, so II is the cause. Answer: II is the cause and I is its effect.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. The price of onions has doubled in the market.
II. Heavy rain destroyed a large part of the onion crop.

Which of the following is correct?
options: I is the cause and II is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
The two statements are independent of each other
II is the cause and I is its effect
questions.explanation: The crop loss reduced supply and raised prices, so II is the cause. Answer: II is the cause and I is its effect.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. Ravi did not study for the test.
II. Ravi failed the test.

Which of the following is correct?
options: II is the cause and I is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
I is the cause and II is its effect
The two statements are independent of each other
questions.explanation: Not studying led to failing, so I is the cause. Answer: I is the cause and II is its effect.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. The price of petrol rose sharply.
II. Bus fares in the city were increased.

Which of the following is correct?
options: II is the cause and I is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
I is the cause and II is its effect
The two statements are independent of each other
questions.explanation: Higher fuel costs led operators to raise fares, so I is the cause. Answer: I is the cause and II is its effect.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. The river overflowed and flooded nearby villages.
II. The dam released a large quantity of water.

Which of the following is correct?
options: I is the cause and II is its effect
II is the cause and I is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
The two statements are independent of each other
questions.explanation: The dam release caused the river to overflow, so II is the cause. Answer: II is the cause and I is its effect.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. Many people in the city fell ill with fever.
II. The municipal water supply was found to be contaminated.

Which of the following is correct?
options: II is the cause and I is its effect
I is the cause and II is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
The two statements are independent of each other
questions.explanation: Contaminated water caused the illnesses, so II is the cause. Answer: II is the cause and I is its effect.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. Demand for air conditioners rose sharply in the city.
II. Summer temperatures reached a record high.

Which of the following is correct?
options: I is the cause and II is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
The two statements are independent of each other
II is the cause and I is its effect
questions.explanation: The record heat caused the rise in demand, so II is the cause. Answer: II is the cause and I is its effect.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. Many people in an area suffered from skin allergies.
II. Fish died in large numbers in a nearby river.

Which of the following is correct?
options: I is the cause and II is its effect
II is the cause and I is its effect
The two statements are independent of each other
Both are effects of a common cause
questions.explanation: Neither causes the other; industrial discharge into the river and surroundings could explain both. Answer: Both are effects of a common cause.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. The price of gold rose sharply last week.
II. A new film became a box-office hit.

Which of the following is correct?
options: I is the cause and II is its effect
II is the cause and I is its effect
The two statements are independent of each other
Both are effects of a common cause
questions.explanation: There is no link in either direction and no common cause. Answer: The two statements are independent of each other.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. The company introduced a new, cheaper model of its phone.
II. The company's market share in that segment increased.

Which of the following is correct?
options: II is the cause and I is its effect
I is the cause and II is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
The two statements are independent of each other
questions.explanation: The cheaper model attracted buyers, so I is the cause. Answer: I is the cause and II is its effect.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. Hospitals reported a rise in patients with breathing problems.
II. Visibility on city roads dropped sharply in the mornings.

Which of the following is correct?
options: Both are effects of a common cause
I is the cause and II is its effect
II is the cause and I is its effect
The two statements are independent of each other
questions.explanation: Dense smog or air pollution would explain both, so they are effects of a common cause. Answer: Both are effects of a common cause.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. The local football team won the district cup.
II. The municipal corporation raised property tax.

Which of the following is correct?
options: The two statements are independent of each other
I is the cause and II is its effect
II is the cause and I is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
questions.explanation: The two events have no connection. Answer: The two statements are independent of each other.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. The bank reduced its lending rates.
II. The central bank cut its policy rate.

Which of the following is correct?
options: I is the cause and II is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
The two statements are independent of each other
II is the cause and I is its effect
questions.explanation: The bank cut its lending rates following the policy-rate cut, so II is the cause. Answer: II is the cause and I is its effect.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. The government cut the import duty on edible oil.
II. The retail price of edible oil fell in the market.

Which of the following is correct?
options: II is the cause and I is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
I is the cause and II is its effect
The two statements are independent of each other
questions.explanation: Lower import duty reduced the cost of importing oil, which brought down retail prices. Answer: I is the cause and II is its effect.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. Many students reported stomach pain after lunch on Tuesday.
II. Several teachers who ate in the school canteen the same day also fell ill.

Which of the following is correct?
options: I is the cause and II is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
II is the cause and I is its effect
The two statements are independent of each other
questions.explanation: Neither group's illness caused the other's; contaminated food in the canteen is a likely common cause. Answer: Both are effects of a common cause.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. Thousands of commuters were stranded at the railway station.
II. The railway employees went on a strike.

Which of the following is correct?
options: I is the cause and II is its effect
II is the cause and I is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
The two statements are independent of each other
questions.explanation: The strike stopped trains and stranded commuters, so II is the cause. Answer: II is the cause and I is its effect.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. A new highway was inaugurated in the district.
II. A famous poet was awarded a national prize.

Which of the following is correct?
options: The two statements are independent of each other
I is the cause and II is its effect
II is the cause and I is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
questions.explanation: The events are unrelated. Answer: The two statements are independent of each other.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. A large number of people migrated from the village to the city.
II. Many village schools had to be closed because of low enrolment.

Which of the following is correct?
options: II is the cause and I is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
The two statements are independent of each other
I is the cause and II is its effect
questions.explanation: Migration reduced the number of children in the village, leading to closures of schools. Answer: I is the cause and II is its effect.

questions.question:
Statements:
I. Farmers in the region lost standing crops.
II. Cattle in the region died in large numbers.

Which of the following is correct?
options: I is the cause and II is its effect
II is the cause and I is its effect
Both are effects of a common cause
The two statements are independent of each other
questions.explanation: Neither caused the other; a severe drought or flood in the region would explain both. Answer: Both are effects of a common cause.
